neighbours.label: time-span and time-of-occurrence phrases (during the day, over years, per year)
fire: The valley turned green over thousands of years of slow erosion.
The museum is crowded during the afternoon in summer.
The coastline retreats about two metres per decade.
Prices are unlikely to fall any time soon, analysts say.
The volcano erupted several times over the last century.
The shop closes for two weeks during the winter holidays.
The forest has been shrinking for decades.
The river freezes solid during the coldest months.
quiet: The valley turned green after a lot of slow erosion.
The museum is crowded near the entrance in summer.
The coastline retreats about two metres in places.
Prices are unlikely to fall in big cities, analysts say.
The volcano erupted with great force and noise.
The shop closes its doors to repair the roof.
The forest has been shrinking because of farming.
The river freezes solid along its shallow edges.
